RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, making it virtually impossible to demonstrate that sex discrimination influenced the outcome. An all-female panel selecting one woman over another does not suggest gender bias, and pointing to the panel’s gender makeup will undermine your credibility.

Your valid concerns center on qualification weighting and procedural transparency. You possess formal administrative leadership credentials and deputy principal experience, whereas the appointed candidate brought extensive teaching experience. Follow up politely on your formal request for a written explanation, framing your inquiry strictly around the selection criteria, qualifications, and feedback for your professional development rather than the panel’s demographics.
